units: map units (map is 0..1000); cooldowns in seconds; slots P passive, Q/W/E basic, R ultimate (Valorant C/Q/E/X)

sources.lol: Riot Data Dragon 16.23.1 (spell names, descriptions, cooldowns, costs, ranges)
sources.wildrift: wildrift.leagueoflegends.com champion pages (ability names, descriptions); cooldowns and ranges approximated from the PC champion
sources.dota2: OpenDota constants from the Dota 2 game files (behaviour, damage type, cooldown, mana, cast range, damage, durations)
sources.mlbb: Mobile Legends Wiki (Fandom, CC BY-SA 3.0) ability templates (cooldown, mana cost, base damage, descriptions)
sources.hok: hokstats.gg hero pages (skill names and short descriptions); numbers approximate

method: Descriptions are classified into reusable effect types (damage, damage over time, stun, knock-up, root, slow, silence, heal, shield, dash, stealth, immunity, buffs, summons, reveal, execute, terrain, global, revive) with targeting and an AI usage tag. Damage magnitude is a multiplier on the engine's per-title standard for the slot; it comes from the source where it lists damage (Dota 2, MLBB), otherwise 1.0. Fields listed in 'approx' are approximations.
